title: No Ghost Blocks
description:
A lightweight Minecraft Fabric client-side mod that fixes ghost blocks caused by client-server desync.
It detects when block states don’t match the server and automatically re-syncs them to remove fake broken or invisible blocks.
body:
A lightweight Minecraft Fabric client-side mod that fixes ghost blocks caused by client-server desync.

It detects when block states don’t match the server and automatically re-syncs them to remove fake broken or invisible blocks.

⚙️ Features
Fixes ghost blocks instantly
Auto re-syncs block states
Packet-based detection
Lightweight & client-side only
